Complex quantities are split: <name>_re/_im (rectangular) or <name>_mag/<name>_deg (polar), as printed. Row tol/tolKind apply to every value unless a 'tols' override exists for that name. Conventions: PS-17/18/19 100 MVA base, line zone 138 kV, T X0=X1=0.10; G-17 ideal tap on bus-1 side with x_t on bus-2 side (Y=[[y/t^2,-y/t],[-y/t,y]]); G-04 Qc = capacitor own rating; PS-14 GS order bus 2 then bus 3 with new V2, PV |V| rescaled to 1.05; G-12 analytic (expm) and RK4 dt 10 ms; PS-24 closed form and RK4 (dt 0.1 ms and 1 ms).
